questions.text: Look at the picture. Which vegetable is orange and long?
questions.discussion: The picture shows a carrot. A carrot is usually orange and long.

image.alt: A chart of vegetables with a carrot

questions.text: Look at the picture. Which vegetable looks like a small green tree?
questions.discussion: Broccoli has a green head that looks like a small tree.

questions.text: Look at the picture. What color is the eggplant?
questions.discussion: The eggplant in the picture is purple.

image.alt: A chart showing a purple eggplant

questions.text: Look at the picture. Which vegetable has green leaves?
questions.discussion: Spinach is a leafy green vegetable.

questions.text: Look at the basket. Which three vegetables can you see?
questions.discussion: The basket illustration contains a carrot, a tomato, and broccoli.

image.alt: A basket containing carrot tomato and broccoli

questions.text: Look at the shapes. Which word describes the red shape?
questions.discussion: The red shape is a circle, so it is round.

questions.text: Look at the picture. Which vegetable is long and orange?
questions.discussion: The carrot is orange and long.

questions.text: Look at the picture. Which vegetable is purple?
questions.discussion: The eggplant is purple in the picture.

questions.text: Look at the basket. Which vegetable is red and round?
questions.discussion: The tomato is red and round in the basket.

image.alt: A basket with a red round tomato

questions.text: Look at the picture. Which two vegetables are green?
questions.discussion: The picture shows broccoli and spinach as green vegetables.

image.alt: A chart showing green broccoli and spinach

questions.text: What is the English word for 'wortel'?
questions.discussion: Carrot is the English word for wortel.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'bayam'?
questions.discussion: Spinach means bayam in Indonesian.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'terong'?
questions.discussion: Eggplant means terong.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'brokoli'?
questions.discussion: Broccoli means brokoli.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'kacang panjang'?
questions.discussion: Snake beans means kacang panjang.

questions.text: What does 'bitter melon' mean in Indonesian?
questions.discussion: Bitter melon is pare.

questions.text: What does 'cauliflower' mean in Indonesian?
questions.discussion: Cauliflower means kembang kol.

questions.text: Which vegetable is usually orange?
questions.discussion: Carrots are commonly orange.

questions.text: Which vegetable is usually purple?
questions.discussion: Eggplants are commonly purple.

questions.text: Which word means 'renyah'?
questions.discussion: Crunchy means renyah, a texture that makes a crisp sound when bitten.

questions.text: Which word means 'panjang'?
questions.discussion: Long means panjang.

questions.text: Which word means 'kecil'?
questions.discussion: Small means kecil.

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence to describe a carrot.
questions.discussion: Use 'It is' to describe one carrot. Orange and long are suitable descriptions.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: 'This is a ___. It is purple.'
questions.discussion: Eggplant is commonly purple, so it completes the description.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: 'Broccoli is ___. '
questions.discussion: Broccoli is green.

questions.text: Which question asks about color?
questions.discussion: The question 'What color is it?' asks about an object's color.

questions.text: Which question asks about the name of a vegetable?
questions.discussion: Use 'What is it?' to ask what an object or vegetable is.

questions.text: Choose the correct plural form of 'carrot'.
questions.discussion: The usual plural form is made by adding -s: carrot becomes carrots.

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
questions.discussion: Use 'These are' for more than one item that is near.

questions.text: Which sentence describes a small vegetable?
questions.discussion: The sentence 'The pea is small' is grammatically correct and gives a simple description.

questions.text: What does 'I like carrots' mean?
questions.discussion: I like means saya suka.

questions.text: Which sentence expresses that you do not like spinach?
questions.discussion: I don't like spinach means saya tidak suka bayam.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: 'I ___ broccoli.' (Saya suka brokoli.)
questions.discussion: Use 'like' with the subject 'I' to express a preference.

questions.text: Complete the question: '___ you like carrots?'
questions.discussion: Use 'Do' to ask a simple present question with 'you'.

questions.text: Choose the correct answer: 'Do you like potatoes?' — 'Yes, ___.'
questions.discussion: 'Yes, I do' is a correct short answer to 'Do you like...?'.

questions.text: Choose the correct answer: 'Do you like bitter melon?' — 'No, ___.'
questions.discussion: 'No, I don't' is the correct short answer when you do not like it.

questions.text: Which sentence tells your favorite vegetable?
questions.discussion: The correct pattern is 'My favorite vegetable is ...'.

questions.text: A: Do you like carrots? B: ___. I like them.
questions.discussion: The response agrees with the statement 'I like them'.

questions.text: A: What is your favorite vegetable? B: ___.
questions.discussion: The question asks for a favorite vegetable, so answer with its name.

questions.text: Which sentence is about a vegetable's color?
questions.discussion: Purple describes the color of the eggplant.

questions.text: Which sentence is about a vegetable's shape?
questions.discussion: Round describes the shape of the tomato.

questions.text: Read: 'This is a carrot. It is orange and crunchy.' What is the text describing?
questions.discussion: The text names a carrot and describes its color and texture.

questions.text: Read: 'I like spinach, but I don't like bitter melon.' Which vegetable does the speaker like?
questions.discussion: The speaker says 'I like spinach', so spinach is the vegetable they like.

questions.text: Read: 'My favorite vegetable is broccoli.' What is the speaker's favorite vegetable?
questions.discussion: The sentence directly says that broccoli is the favorite vegetable.

questions.text: Your friend asks, 'Do you like eggplant?' You do not like it. What should you say?
questions.discussion: Say 'No, I don't' to answer that you do not like eggplant.

questions.text: You want to say 'Saya suka kacang polong.' Which sentence is correct?
questions.discussion: I like peas means saya suka kacang polong.

questions.text: Which sentence is the best description of a potato?
options: It is always purple and grows on a tree.
It is a long orange fruit.
It is usually brown outside and grows underground.
It has green flowers and flies.
questions.answer: It is usually brown outside and grows underground.
questions.discussion: A potato commonly has brown skin and grows underground.

questions.text: Which sentence uses 'don't' correctly?
questions.discussion: With 'I', use don't + base verb: I don't like.

questions.text: Which pair contains two vegetables?
questions.discussion: Carrot and broccoli are both vegetables.

questions.text: You are making a shopping list. Which sentence is correct?
questions.discussion: Use 'We need' to say what is needed on a shopping list.
